find: if (host.isSurfaceOpen(surface)) for (const cb of closeCbs) cb();
killedBy: createControllersPane (issue #556) releases only a pane that is on screen
why: Tells this pane's subscribers to tear down when it was never on screen. `release` is the sibling-replacing path (issue #558): an incoming pane fades this surface out, so only the subscribers are released. Without the open guard a replace that never involved this pane still fires its close, stopping a gamepad poller nobody started. Survives all 341 `createHud` cases, because the layer stack only ever releases a pane it actually replaced.
